description: This file contains functions and procedures for DHCP protocol configuration and management in OpenWRT's netifd system, including initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown of DHCP client processes.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds DHCP send options if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_get_default_clientid
methods.description: Generates default DHCP client ID based on interface and DUID.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCP client with specified configuration and options.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_renew
methods.description: Forces DHCP lease renewal by sending SIGUSR1 to udhcpc.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_teardown
methods.description: Kills DHCP client process for the specified interface.
